maintenance_led.reason: Revenue comes from distributing new software licences and cloud subscriptions (Wolfpack, Grey Matter, Soft-Sell, Interworks.cloud), not repair or maintenance.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are IT resellers and VARs buying software from vendors; revenue is paid by private businesses, with only some education software.

serial_acquirer.reason: Website states a growth-through-acquisition strategy, with six acquisitions completed, including Interworks.cloud, DSS and several UK and Canadian distributors.

mission_critical.reason: Specialty IT distribution to resellers; vendors and resellers can move to other distributors, so switching costs are modest.

notes: Switching cost for resellers is uncertain; distribution is generally substitutable, but vendor relationships and enablement add some stickiness.
